result.summary: Several restaurant cards and category chips are clipped at the screen edges, hiding names, delivery info, and extra categories.

issues.description: The third restaurant card in 'Fastest near you' is cut off on the right, so the name reads 'Trattoria Piccol' and the rest of the card is hidden.
issues.suggestion: Add enough right padding or fade/peek so full names and delivery fees stay visible, or make the carousel clearly swipeable with a visible peek of the next card.

issues.description: The category filter row is clipped on the right (Healthy chip cut off, next chip barely visible), so users cannot see all filters.
issues.suggestion: Show a clear overflow/scroll affordance and avoid cutting chip labels in half.

issues.description: The bottom restaurant promo card is cropped by the tab bar, hiding most of the offer content.
issues.suggestion: Add bottom padding so the last card sits fully above the navigation bar.
